biography_english: A blind swordsman of Lodissian descent. It seems he is connected to the Dark Knights somehow, but he will not speak on the matter.
biography_spanish: Un espadachin ciego de origen lodisiano. Parece estar vinculado a los Caballeros Oscuros de algun modo, pero no habla del tema.

biography_english:
A Lodissian swordmaster who once served with the Dark Knights Loslorien. He is the second son of Stratarchis Vogras, a Lodissian of great influence, and is brother to the Dark Knight Balxephon. He bears the title "Steelsong."
  Accused of patricide, his eyes were gouged out, and he was banished from Lodis. Hobyrim came to Valeria seeking vengeance against the true culprit, his brother Balxephon.
biography_spanish:
Un maestro de la espada lodisiano que sirvio en los Caballeros Oscuros Loslorien. Es segundo hijo del estratarca Vogras, lodisiano de gran influencia, y hermano del Caballero Oscuro Balxephon. Ostenta el titulo "Vozferrea".  
  Acusado de parricidio, le vaciaron los ojos y fue desterrado de Lodis. Hobyrim vino a Valeria buscando venganza contra el verdadero culpable, su hermano Balxephon.

A Galgastani from Rhime who once led the Wyrmknights of the Kingdom of Galgastan.
  As Hierophant Balbatos's right hand, he was a principal agent in carrying out the blood war. He later joined those opposing the Hierophant, troubled by the acts he had been made to commit.

biography_english:
A disciple of the Sea God Vasque who survived a purge of the enemies of Hierophant Balbatos. Her village was attacked by Jeunan's wyrmknights, and now lies in ruin. A handful of survivors took shelter at Lhazan Fortress.
  Ocionne attacked a Bakram force advancing on the fortress with her dragons, but the fight did not go in her favor, and she was captured.
biography_spanish:
Discipula del Dios del Mar Vasque sobrevivio a la purga del Hierofante Balbatos. Su aldea fue atacada por caballero Dragon de Jeunan y yace en ruinas. Pocos supervivientes se refugiaron en la Fortaleza de Lhazan.        
  Ocionne ataco con sus dragones a las tropas bakram que avanzaban a la fortaleza, pero la lucha no fue a su favor y fue capturada.

biography_english:
A disciple of the Sea God Vasque who survived a purge of the enemies of Hierophant Balbatos. Her village was attacked by Jeunan's wyrmknights, and now lies in ruin. A handful of survivors took shelter at Lhazan Fortress.

  The Bakram attacked the fortress, and all the villagers save Ocionne were slaughtered. She was slain attempting to avenge them.
